---

Describe the expected behavior and what happened.

Include a minimal reproduction using synthetic tables and rows, the PQL query,
and the relevant redacted error. Never include credentials, connection strings,
customer data, or saved feature matrices. For a security issue, follow
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Synthefy/nori-rel/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

Record:

- Nori-Rel, Python, operating system, and connector versions
- Database engine/version and local or hosted inference mode
- Synthefy SDK and, for local inference, model runtime/version
- Whether the problem reproduces with the documented synthetic example
